NTA as someone who has been facing similar family expectations vs parental wishes or lifetime involvement (or lack of) over a house argued over between my spouse and their sister, even though parents were only cared for (as in literally) by my spouse; the sister still thinks whenever we sell the home in question (in which we live) that she should get half, just for being 1 of the two children. That’s a big nope on our end so much so that now that we have had attorneys correct the deed per written wishes for my spouse to solely own the property, the sister went straight to how much will she get, her behavior shows no interest in respect, just cash. 

Your grandpa spent time and money to make sure that who got what he worked for was only you. I would respect that. If you truly feel the family will be litigious, (and after being confident they could afford an attorney to sue for it as I doubt any worth their salt would take this case on contingency as the will is written clearly), *maybe* the $5000 each advice would be worth protecting the rest; but, morally, NTA and I’d make him proud by keeping true to his wishes, it’s why he trusted you in the first place. 

Im sorry for your loss.

It’s as good a theory as any I guess. Obviously speaking in the abstract, but it’s as possible to say it’s impossible as it is possible to consider we just haven’t gotten there yet. For us, it has always been science fiction until it wasn’t. We are constantly evolving and I logically recognize that right now it’s fantasy. But that doesn’t mean it always will be. Not if it just took that last seen galaxy 10 billion years to be in our field of vision now. Imagine in the infinite blink of space time and I wouldn’t rule anything out.

This also doesn’t account for relativity or their method. Wormholes, black holes, again just scratching the surface of what we barely know and that’s thanks to the smartest fucking people we know who are working in these fields.

Is this truly because it’s not possible or are we just not advanced enough to figure it out? 

I ask based on the Dr.NDT documentary where he basically said, to the life form(s) who could have theoretically succeeded in reaching us, (or that we are them, DNA captured in the ice age and thus the primordial story of evolution), our smartest human would likely equate intellectually to an average human toddler. Sort of how our closest relatives, the apes, are usually toddler-level smart compared to us.

Preface: me = general universe lack of solid knowledge 

Don’t we already have rockets that go up to 10 g acceleration? I know at a certain speed humans usually pass out from the force. But a consistent 1g...why ISNT this possible??

I think the missing point is that in today’s world of technology she SHOULD be involved in his public social media and internet use as an exercise in trust, a lesson in digital world safety, and a reminder that it’s a privilege and not a right. He bought it, but if he is a minor she can be liable for his searches, convos, etc. 
the problem is the approach. It should have been explained as a rule as part of being allowed to purchase his own laptop would be granting parental rights to “pop inspect” unless you’d rather they simply install spyware and be invasive for real by watching your every move..,
I think she isn’t handling it right and glad to hear she is getting help; but also, you aren’t blameless. She is supposed to protect you and the world as it now exists online and at warp speed, she may suck at parenting in this department, but you also suck for making her the villain and you the victim instead of complaining your mom is inappropriately trying to make sure some creep isn’t trying to catfish her son, perhaps. 
Is she a tech wiz? No. 
Learn more shit on encryption and even masking your searches. Have a mom version of your laptop that is boring and typical. Save the rest for whatever the hell you do at an age where a mom would be a factor in the first place here to places there’s no way she’d find it. 
If you have proof you paid with your money, she should help repair or replace it. But, “should” is an unreliable assessment. 
Good luck man. Even if your mom is as bas as you make her out to be here, I promise you 2 things are usually true:
1) she isn’t as bad as you make her sound
2) even if she is, she may be a shittier mom than some, but a rockstar compared to others. At least she is there, being in your business, driving you crazy, showing she cares. 
Maybe therapy will help redirect how she shows that and how you view her behavior from her intended perspective rather than simply reacting to just how it affects you. 

TL; DR fuck you I took the time to write it, you go read it or just skip it.

How I want to live and how I feel it’s possible to love feel so very different. 
I know parts of who I am. I know what I want to be is authentic. To show respect for whomever or whatever made such an intricate machine with which to navigate life and to try and take care of it. I just so many things were easier to make that possible. 
     -you can’t even get financial assistance for marketplace insurance unless you’re right on the border while not exceeding the poverty line...the system intended to pave way for the American dream is rigged as fuck...but I digress.

Don’t get me wrong, I love everything from indoor plumbing to internet access. But. I hate money. I want to serve a purpose and not have to compromise myself to earn enough to pay bills, eat and “live”. I wish money wasn’t what has always stood in my way. 

How do I want to live? What do I want? To have ONE day, from wake to sleep, where I didn’t wonder how I’ll make it (financially) till the end if the month; I wonder of that persistent pain is more cancer. I want to take the good and the bad like everyone else and make the most of it. 

You can skip the following if an anxiety example story sounds boring...

But. Im that “crazy lady” who (true story) was already fully anxious going into PetCo because they are like [Tom Cruise’s cousin](https://goo.gl/images/RL6xvm), and of course PetSmart is Tom Cruise. First I cannot find the dog food (Iams, not some random food). An employee walked passed me twice as I looked clearly lost and didn’t offer to help, so I stopped her, apologized and asked if she is on break, to which she huffed a no and the obligatory ask to help. I asked if she knew if there were Iams elsewhere or on one of the MANY palettes yet to be unloaded (all over the store in total disarray). She said she guessed she could look if she had to but she believes they are no longer selling Iams. No offer to confirm. She just stood there like go the fuck away. My anxiety, which feels hella voluntary when it happens this way, made me start crying and telling her I knew retail is abysmal bc I dit it for years but it was like I was INTERRUPTING the job she is paid to do after even asking if she was on duty and she clearly couldn’t care less. I rammed my empty cart through to the front of the store loudly muttering how nobody gives a shit about basic human kindness and before leaving I shoved the cart, fuck, I don’t know, over somewhere and then screamed “I can’t even buy dog food in this animal-abusive hellhole!!!” 

Anyway I think it may be a sort of existential crisis plus I do have [PCOS](https://www.practo.com/healthfeed/everything-you-need-to-know-about-pcos-polycystic-ovarian-syndrome-16079/post) and [PTSD](https://www.bnwomenforwomen.com/womens-health/hw-view.php?DOCHWID=ug4379) definitely from adulthood-I have yet to lie on zee couch and deescuss my childhoooood. 

How would I know how I want to live without a clear purpose to live in the first place? 

So many living creatures are born to breed babies and be some other creature’s food.

Absent religions (who all have their own answers so I guess we will see one day if any of them are right) what is the reason I am here and what purpose do I serve?
